name: Carrera
source: A female alchemist. She admires and respects her scientist father, Greg, but cannot be completely honest with him, so she pursued the path of alchemy. Like her father, she has a mad scientist streak and is obsessed with fantasies of world domination. She refers to the protagonist as “Servant No. 1” and wears a claw on her right hand for some reason. In the novel version, Gema is her servant.
